title: Crunchbase Scraper Input
description: Configure what to scrape from Crunchbase. Provide company URLs, company names, or search by industry/location/funding stage.

companyUrls.title: Company Crunchbase URLs
companyUrls.description: List of full Crunchbase company URLs to scrape. Example: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/openai

companyNames.title: Company Names
companyNames.description: List of company names to look up on Crunchbase. Each name is resolved to its Crunchbase organization page.

searchIndustry.title: Search by Industry
searchIndustry.description: Search Crunchbase organizations by industry or category. Example: 'Artificial Intelligence', 'FinTech', 'SaaS'

searchLocation.title: Search by Location
searchLocation.description: Filter search results by location (city, state, or country). Example: 'San Francisco', 'United States'

searchFundingStage.title: Search by Funding Stage
searchFundingStage.description: Filter search results by funding stage.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of company profiles to scrape (search mode only).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are strongly recommended for reliable scraping.
